optimized_sql:
SELECT *
FROM (
    SELECT
        dw1.i_category AS i_category,
        dw1.i_class AS i_class,
        dw1.i_brand AS i_brand,
        dw1.i_product_name AS i_product_name,
        dw1.d_year AS d_year,
        dw1.d_qoy AS d_qoy,
        dw1.d_moy AS d_moy,
        dw1.s_store_id AS s_store_id,
        dw1.sumsales AS sumsales,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY dw1.i_category ORDER BY dw1.sumsales DESC) AS rk
    FROM (
        SELECT
            i.i_category AS i_category,
            i.i_class AS i_class,
            i.i_brand AS i_brand,
            i.i_product_name AS i_product_name,
            pre.d_year AS d_year,
            pre.d_qoy AS d_qoy,
            pre.d_moy AS d_moy,
            s.s_store_id AS s_store_id,
            SUM(pre.part_sales) AS sumsales
        FROM (
            SELECT
                ss.ss_item_sk AS ss_item_sk,
                ss.ss_store_sk AS ss_store_sk,
                d.d_year AS d_year,
                d.d_qoy AS d_qoy,
                d.d_moy AS d_moy,
                SUM(COALESCE(ss.ss_sales_price * ss.ss_quantity, 0)) AS part_sales
            FROM store_sales AS ss
            INNER JOIN date_dim AS d ON d.d_date_sk = ss.ss_sold_date_sk
            WHERE d.d_month_seq BETWEEN 1217 AND 1217 + 11
            GROUP BY ss.ss_item_sk, ss.ss_store_sk, d.d_year, d.d_qoy, d.d_moy
        ) AS pre
        INNER JOIN item AS i ON i.i_item_sk = pre.ss_item_sk
        INNER JOIN store AS s ON s.s_store_sk = pre.ss_store_sk
        GROUP BY ROLLUP (
            i.i_category,
            i.i_class,
            i.i_brand,
            i.i_product_name,
            pre.d_year,
            pre.d_qoy,
            pre.d_moy,
            s.s_store_id
        )
    ) AS dw1
) AS dw2
WHERE dw2.rk <= 100
ORDER BY
    dw2.i_category,
    dw2.i_class,
    dw2.i_brand,
    dw2.i_product_name,
    dw2.d_year,
    dw2.d_qoy,
    dw2.d_moy,
    dw2.s_store_id,
    dw2.sumsales,
    dw2.rk
LIMIT 100
